insights.worldBrief: The UN condemned a deadly wave of drone strikes in Sudan [1]. Europe is preparing for direct talks with Putin, with a proposal that Russia gets Donbas and Ukraine gets NATO membership, according to the FT [2]. Trump said the US is winning the war and 'can leave right now' [3].

briefStoryLines.text: UN condemns deadly wave of drone strikes in war-torn Sudan, UN News reports. [1]
Europe prepares for direct talks with Putin; proposal: Russia gets Donbas, Ukraine gets NATO membership, FT reports. [2]
Trump says US is winning war and 'can leave right now', ABC News reports. [3]
Marine Corps Battalion redesignates as first medium missile battalion, Pentagon reports. [4]
Jon Stewart calls Trump waiving Russia sanctions 'insane' and 'incoherent', The Hill reports. [5]
Ukrainian parliament member says Trump 'should apply his creativity' to end Russia's war, CBS News reports. [6]
Russian lawmakers want to triple prison terms for online 'calls to riot', Meduza reports. [7]
Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 73 security recruits, local authorities say [8]
